limitations: Assistant-performed offline content/source/arithmetic review, not independent human expert validation.
No application case, live model, judge, publication or approval flow was executed; zero application passes are claimed.
Only public d01-d13 and public cached SEC facts/submissions were read. No protected held-out/red-team content was accessed.
Original own-year annual presentations are explicitly pinned for reproducibility. Their use is an adopted answer contract, not a claim of current source eligibility.

Companyfacts supply USD concept facts, CIK, dates and accession metadata, but not a full rendering of statement cells, all dimensions/footnotes, continuing-operation/perimeter judgments or complete amendment/non-reliance histories.
The cached SEC filing URLs were constructed from verified submissions metadata and not reopened. No network access was used.
Bank net-interest/noninterest arithmetic bridges corroborate the chosen denominator but do not certify GAAP-versus-managed/FTE presentation, full consolidation or peer comparability.
The BAC name conflict is retained as a concrete source issue; arithmetic and CIK matching do not explain it. No issuer-name correction is invented.
Numerical matches alone do not establish risk changes, financial causes, usefulness, safety, benchmark success or publication eligibility.
